inlineSql: SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY A.EDIT_DATE,A.CO_BOOK,A.VCH_NO) AS SrNo,A.CO_BOOK,B.BOOK_NAME,B.MAIN_BOOK,C.AC_NAME,A.VCH_NO,A.VCH_DATE,A.EDIT_DATE,A.USER_NAME,A.NEW_USER,A.AC_CODE,A.ENTRY_CHECK FROM (USER_DATA AS A LEFT JOIN BOOK_DATA AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND A.LC_CODE = B.LC_CODE AND A.CO_BOOK = B.CO_BOOK)LEFT JOIN AC_MAST AS C ON A.CO_CODE = C.CO_CODE AND A.AC_CODE = C.AC_CODE WHERE A.CO_CODE =' ? ' AND A.LC_CODE = ' ? ' ? AND ENTRY_CHECK <> 'Y' ? AND A.USER_NAME = ' ? ' ? AND A.CO_BOOK = ' ? ' ? AND A.AC_CODE = ' ? ' ? AND A.EDIT_DATE >= ' ? MM/dd/yyyy ? ' AND A.EDIT_DATE <= ' ? MM/dd/yyyy ? ' ? C ? AND B.DATA_TYPE = ' ? ' ? GROUP BY A.CO_BOOK,B.BOOK_NAME,B.MAIN_BOOK,C.AC_NAME,A.VCH_NO,A.VCH_DATE,A.EDIT_DATE,A.USER_NAME,A.NEW_USER,A.AC_CODE,A.ENTRY_CHECK ORDER BY A.EDIT_DATE,A.CO_BOOK,A.VCH_NO

Select ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY A.EDIT_DATE DESC) As SrNo,A.CO_BOOK,B.BOOK_NAME,B.MAIN_BOOK,C.AC_NAME,A.VCH_NO,A.VCH_DATE,A.EDIT_DATE,A.USER_NAME,A.NEW_USER,A.AC_CODE,A.ENTRY_CHECK,A.COL_TYPE,A.OLD_VAL,A.NEW_VAL,A.ENTRY_TIME FROM (USER_DATA As A LEFT JOIN BOOK_DATA As B On A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE And A.LC_CODE = B.LC_CODE And A.CO_BOOK = B.CO_BOOK)LEFT JOIN AC_MAST As C On A.CO_CODE = C.CO_CODE And A.AC_CODE = C.AC_CODE WHERE A.CO_CODE =' ? ' AND A.LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.CO_BOOK = ' ? ' AND A.VCH_NO = ' ? ' AND A.EDIT_DATE >= ' ? MM/dd/yyyy ? ' AND A.EDIT_DATE <= ' ? MM/dd/yyyy ? ' ? C ? AND B.DATA_TYPE = ' ? ' ? ORDER BY A.EDIT_DATE DESC
